changes: Updated `newest_ids` and `owner_ids` to sort temporary lists instead of mutating caller-owned rows. Added regressions for export order after both views and stable newest-item tie ordering.
diagnosis: Both read-only sorted views used `rows.sort(...)`, modifying import order in place. Subsequent exports therefore reflected view order.
verification: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`: all 5 tests passed. `python3 -m py_compile catalog.py tests/test_public.py`: passed.
